title: RuntimeDriverManifest
description: Metadata file (driver.json) that every runtime driver under ./runtime-drivers/<driver_id>/ MUST publish. Drivers are the deterministic I/O layer used by STEP 3 (driveEmployeeOnScenario) to talk to the evaluatee sandbox. The contract layer NEVER references a specific protocol; protocol-specific code lives only inside a driver directory.

driver_id.description: Stable identifier. MUST equal the driver's directory basename. Referenced by EvaluationContext.runtime_driver.driver_id.

version.description: Semver-style version of this driver implementation.

entry.description: Relative path (within the driver directory) to the executable entrypoint that STEP 3 invokes. Typical value: 'run.py'.

language.description: Language/runtime hint for the entrypoint. Optional.

produces.description: Every driver MUST emit ExecutionTrace. No exceptions. Pinned to make this contract literally checkable.

consumes.description: Inputs the driver reads. The minimum is enriched_test_case.schema.json (one per scenario). evaluation_context.schema.json is included when the driver needs paths or driver_config.

capabilities.description: Optional self-declared capabilities. STEP 3 may use these for routing decisions (e.g. multi-turn vs single-shot).

config_schema.description: JSON Schema fragment that EvaluationContext.runtime_driver.driver_config MUST validate against. STEP 3 MUST run this validation before invoking the entrypoint.

notes.description: Optional human-readable notes for driver authors / reviewers.
